data.description: Adds the Iron Tyrant, a boss with a boss bar.
data.name: Boss

meta.notes: The mod metadata, written to fabric.mod.json when you export the Fabric mod jar. New mobs exist only in that jar, which also needs Fabric API, msm_runtime and, on targets that have it, GeckoLib (nested in the jar unless you choose to keep them separate); without GeckoLib the runtime draws the mob itself. The mod id must stay unique among the mods you install.
